#define MD_FLAG_HARD_SOFT_BREAKS            0x8000  /* Force all soft breaks to act as hard breaks. */
#define MD_FLAG_SPOILERS                    0x10000 /* Enable ||hidden text|| spoiler spans. */

dependency_reason: Collects a double pipe as one mark when the spoiler flag is set.
Passes unresolved double-pipe marks to the spoiler resolver.
Turns resolved double-pipe marks into spoiler span callbacks.
